def: Beer, a place in the Desert, also one in Palestine

words.word: and from thence they went to beer

occurrences.text: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the Lord spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
words: And from thence they went to Beer

occurrences.text: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
